(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

3Red Partners is a proprietary trading firm focused on leveraging technology and mathematics to implement sophisticated trading strategies. The Graduate C++ Developer will implement, test, deploy, monitor, and improve high-frequency trading system features and tools while collaborating with traders and developers to diagnose and resolve performance issues.
C++ developer building, debugging, and optimizing low-latency trading systems

Responsibilities:
• Implement, test, and deploy trading system features and tools according to business needs
• Monitor low latency trading system performance, ensure market data and research resource utilization issues are tracked, bugs are fixed and deployed appropriately
• Liaise internally with traders and developers to discuss performance optimizations, vet ideas and questions, refactor existing implementation, and monitor updates to the OS, libraries, and current internal frameworks
• Investigate improvements to the trading system; diagnose, debug, and address issues when needed

Requirements:
• A student completing a bachelor's, master's, or PhD degree with an emphasis in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, graduating in 2027 by August 2027
• 1+ industry internships working in C++
• Experience with coding languages, specifically, C++ (data structures)
• Knowledge of low-level systems, third-party libraries (i.e. STL and Boost), linux environments, git
• Exceptional problem solving, written, and verbal communication skills
